name: American Express Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer Ascend Credit Card

mpd:travel.note: On eligible Singapore Airlines and Scoot flight bookings, KrisShop and Pelago purchases

mpd:flight_booking.note: On eligible Singapore Airlines and Scoot flight bookings, KrisShop and Pelago purchases

highlights: 2 miles for every dollar spent on eligible Singapore Airlines and Scoot flights, plus up to 2 mpd on eligible Grab Singapore transactions, up to S$200 spend in each calendar month. and 1.2 mpd on other local and foreign currency purchases.

pros: Spend S$15,000 or more on eligible Singapore Airlines and Scoot flight bookings within the first 12 months upon Card approval to be automatically upgraded to the KrisFlyer Elite Gold membership tier. T&Cs apply.
pros: Get a complimentary night stay at participating Hilton properties each year.
pros: Receive a Foreign Spend Miles Redemption Voucher for 18,000 KrisFlyer miles when you spend the equivalent of S$10,000 or more in foreign currency within the qualifying period.
pros: Receive a Renewal Miles Redemption Voucher for 10,000 KrisFlyer miles after American Express receives payment of the renewal annual membership fee each year.
pros: Earn 2 KrisFlyer miles for every S$1 spent on eligible Singapore Airlines and Scoot flight bookings, KrisShop and Pelago purchases, with no cap.
pros: Earn 1.2 KrisFlyer miles for every S$1 spent on all other eligible purchases, with no cap.

pros: Enjoy hassle-free conversion as all KrisFlyer miles earned with the American Express Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer Ascend Credit Card are conveniently credited directly into your KrisFlyer account.
pros: Accelerated upgrade to KrisFlyer Elite Gold membership tier
pros: Annual fee: S$397.85 (inclusive of GST) must be paid to enjoy welcome offers.

citation.title: American Express Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer Ascend Credit Card

extra.tag: Best for KrisFlyer shopping and spending
extra.description: Soar to greater heights with the American Express Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer Ascend Credit Card. Designed for loyal Singapore Airlines customers, this card allows you to earn up to 2 KrisFlyer miles per S$1 spent on eligible purchases. Plus, enjoy a complimentary one-night stay at participating Hilton properties each year. All KrisFlyer miles earned with your Card are conveniently credited directly into your KrisFlyer account.
